name: Prophet
when_to_use: Time series with multiple seasonality/holidays and nonlinear trend; robust to outliers and missing data.

expected_input.question: How to forecast a time series with multiple seasonality?
expected_input.note: Needs adaptation before running (see the notes field).

plain_explanation.purpose: Forecasts series with strong seasonality and holidays, automatically and with little configuration.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the series has a weekly/yearly pattern, gaps in the data or special dates.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Two columns: date and value; ideally months or years of history.
plain_explanation.example: Forecast daily visits to a website, with peaks on commemorative dates.
